input_requirements.jaw_handling: separate upper/lower files; same Z direction for both jaws
input_requirements.axis: Y axis points toward the back; axes must follow the README reference orientation
input_requirements.preprocessing: farthest-point sampled vertices; inference path accepts the original OBJ parent and samples internally
input_requirements.sample_counts: TGNet path uses 24000 total points; boundary stage uses 20000 boundary points and fills remaining points to 24000; crop_sample_size=3072
input_requirements.sampling_determinism: not established as deterministic; repository calls resample_pcd with FPS and uniform sampling and has no benchmark seed contract
input_requirements.required_future_conversion: Create research-only OBJ copies from canonical STL, preserve a source-to-OBJ mapping, and verify axis orientation before any future benchmark. Do not convert canonical files in place.

output_contract.format: JSON files in save_path, matching challenge ground-truth JSON format
output_contract.fdi: The inference pipeline maps semantic labels to upper/lower tooth numbering; exact JSON field schema must be verified during a future run
output_contract.confidence: not documented as a stable output field
output_contract.landmarks: not available in documented inference path
output_contract.original_correspondence: The pipeline predicts on sampled points, then uses nearest-neighbor transfer back to org_feats vertices and asserts output length equals original vertex count. This supports deterministic original-vertex labels after a successful run, but original face labels and exact JSON indexing still require validation.
output_contract.mesh_reconstruction: Potentially derivable from original vertices and predicted per-vertex instance labels; not yet validated. Original face membership can be reconstructed only by applying vertex labels to source faces, with ambiguous mixed-label faces handled explicitly.

hardware_feasibility.cloud_gpu_16gb_basis: Repository states minimum 11 GB GPU RAM and batch size 1; 16 GB exceeds the documented minimum, but CUDA 11.0/custom pointops compatibility and runtime headroom must be validated before execution.
hardware_feasibility.cloud_gpu_24gb_basis: 24 GB exceeds the documented 11 GB minimum and provides more headroom; repository still notes RTX40 issues, so an older CUDA-compatible GPU may reduce compatibility risk.
hardware_feasibility.required_stack: PyTorch 1.7.1 CUDA 11.0 image, custom pointops, open3d, multimethod, termcolor, trimesh, easydict; exact dependency installation was intentionally not attempted.
